cues.en: that you're trying to point to a cell and you're trying to tell Excel, hey, I want this cell to be relative. I want this one to be absolute. cues.zh: 你经常要指向某个单元格，告诉 Excel：嘿，这个单元格我要相对引用，那个我要绝对引用。所以有个键盘快捷键，你必须学会：Mac 上是 Command-T，Windows 上是 F4。记住它，看看它是干什么的。我现在按一下 Command-T，D24 就变成了 $D24、D$24 这样，超级方便，省得我按 Shift、再按美元符号等等。实际上，按一下 Command-T 就能在四种引用类型之间来回切换。

cues.en: You're always going to start out with a relative reference. That's the default. The first time you hit Command-T, you'll get absolute in both directions. Second time you'll hit it, you'll get a relative in the column dimension, but absolute in the row dimension, and then it'll switch it, and then it'll switch back. So Command-T just switches between these four modes. And this is the one I wanted right now. And let's fill down. Remember, Command-T, F4 on Windows.
cues.zh: 你一开始用的都是相对引用，那是默认状态。第一次按 Command-T，行和列两个方向都变成绝对引用；第二次按，列方向变成相对、行方向保持绝对；再按一下就反过来，再按又切回去。所以 Command-T 就是在这四种模式之间切换。我现在要的就是这一种。接着往下填充。记住，Mac 是 Command-T，Windows 是 F4。
